notes.title: Phucker in the Ashes released!
notes.notes:
After many moons of development, the ultimate telling of the Phucker Saga is finally here: Phucker in the Ashes. It contains Woods, Gulag, and Rome, along with the all new Novel. It also includes bloopers, concept art, Backalleys Infinity, and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513530/Phucker_in_the_Ashes/

For those who have already played one or more of the games, here is a list of upgrades to the original games:

WOODS ADDITIONS
- Added self-investigate mode
- Extra scene (Ryukaze's dream)
- Piss filter and Christian Gamer mode options
- Secret item
- Sound quotes in profile
- Jack Banger as character

GULAG ADDITIONS
- Added self-investigate mode
- All BG's updated to HD
- Extra scene (Save Piotr)
- Big Head mode
- Secret item
- Sound quotes in profiles
- Prometheus the Werehog as character

ROME ADDITIONS
- Striker as character

notes.title: 100 reviews! Phucker in the Woods coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hey Gulaggers.

Flippity dippity doo doggie! 100 reviews! Myself and Lazrool are thrilled that there are as many gaming degenerates out there and enjoying the game. We had fun making the game and have more Phucker news for you all:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34886523/f7fb25664dbb4a0c569216d662479a1135918e71.png[/img]

Phucker in the Woods - The prequel to Gulag, Woods is the first game in the series and explores the origins of the Hiroshi and Ryukaze. It's planned to be released on August 15th.

Phucker in the Rome - The third and final installment of the Phucker Saga, this will conclude the epic storyline in a way that will probably make no sense. It's planned to be released sometime this year, and more info will be available when Woods is released.

Thanks to everyone once again.
